description: Defines the RocketChatField class, a custom UI element for chat input with cursor management, text editing, and event handling, used within the Unvanquished game engine's UI system.

classes.name: RocketChatField
classes.description: A custom UI element for chat input with cursor control, text editing, and command processing.

methods.name: RocketChatField
methods.description: Constructor initializing the chat input element, setting up child elements and state.

methods.name: OnRender
methods.description: Handles rendering the cursor and updating its position.

methods.name: OnUpdate
methods.description: Updates cursor freeze time when focused.

methods.name: OnChildAdd
methods.description: Sets up event listeners when a child element is added.

methods.name: OnAttributeChange
methods.description: Handles changes to element attributes, notably 'exec'.

methods.name: ProcessEvent
methods.description: Processes focus, blur, resize, keydown, and text input events for text editing and command execution.

methods.name: GetIntrinsicDimensions
methods.description: Calculates element dimensions based on font and CSS properties.

methods.name: MoveCursorForward
methods.description: Moves cursor to the next character.

methods.name: MoveCursorBackward
methods.description: Moves cursor to the previous character.

methods.name: UpdateCursorPosition
methods.description: Updates cursor position based on text and cursor index.

methods.name: UpdateText
methods.description: Updates the displayed text and handles special formatting.

methods.name: q2rml
methods.description: Converts custom formatted string to RML elements, preserving colors and special characters.
